points.title: 童年与少年时代
points.description: 三岛由纪夫出生于东京一个没落的贵族家庭，原名平冈公威。自幼体弱多病，由祖母抚养长大，受到严格的贵族教育。1944年进入学习院大学，开始文学创作。这一时期他阅读了大量西方文学，尤其是希腊悲剧和日本古典文学，形成了独特的审美观。他的童年经历和贵族身份背景，为他后来的作品提供了丰富的素材，也塑造了他对美、死亡和荣誉的独特理解。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Tokyo into a declining aristocratic family, Yukio Mishima was originally named Kimitake Hiraoka. Raised by his grandmother due to poor health, he received strict aristocratic education. In 1944, he entered Gakushuin University and began his literary career. During this period, he extensively read Western literature, particularly Greek tragedies and Japanese classics, forming a unique aesthetic perspective. His childhood experiences and aristocratic background provided rich material for his later works and shaped his unique understanding of beauty, death, and honor.

points.title: 文坛崛起
points.description: 1944年，三岛由纪夫发表处女作《假面的告白》，引起文坛关注。1946年，他拜访著名作家川端康成，得到其赏识和指导。1948年，他正式以'三岛由纪夫'为笔名发表作品。这一时期他创作了《虚假的告白》、《潮骚》等作品，确立了其独特的文学风格。三岛的作品融合了东西方文化元素，探讨了人性、美与死亡等主题，展现出对传统日本美学的独特诠释和对现代性的批判。
points.descriptionEn: In 1944, Mishima published his debut work 'Confessions of a Mask', attracting attention in the literary world. In 1946, he visited renowned writer Yasunari Kawabata, who recognized his talent and mentored him. In 1948, he officially adopted the pen name 'Yukio Mishima'. During this period, he created works such as 'The Temple of the Golden Pavilion' and 'The Sound of Waves', establishing his unique literary style. Mishima's works integrated Eastern and Western cultural elements, exploring themes of human nature, beauty, and death, showing his unique interpretation of traditional Japanese aesthetics and critique of modernity.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 这一时期是三岛由纪夫创作的黄金时代，他发表了《金阁寺》、《丰饶之海》四部曲、《近代能乐集》等重要作品。1957年，他开始练习剑道，追求身体与精神的统一。1963年，他建立自己的私人剧团'浪曼派'，致力于传统艺术的现代化。三岛的作品充满对美的极致追求和对死亡的迷恋，他通过文学探索日本传统与现代的冲突，以及战后日本社会的精神危机。这一时期他的作品获得了国际声誉，成为日本战后文学的代表人物。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked Mishima's golden age of creation, during which he published important works such as 'The Temple of the Golden Pavilion', the four-part tetralogy 'The Sea of Fertility', and 'Five Modern Noh Plays'. In 1957, he began practicing kendo, seeking unity of body and spirit. In 1963, he established his private theater troupe 'Rommel-za', dedicated to modernizing traditional arts. Mishima's works were filled with extreme pursuit of beauty and fascination with death. Through literature, he explored the conflict between Japanese tradition and modernity, as well as the spiritual crisis of post-war Japanese society. His works gained international reputation during this period, making him a representative figure of post-war Japanese literature.

points.title: 政治转向
points.description: 1968年，三岛由纪夫成立'楯会'，一个主张恢复天皇权威、反对西方化的右翼组织。他开始公开表达对日本战后民主制度的批判，呼吁回归传统价值观。1969年，他完成最后一部小说《丰饶之海》第四部《天人五衰》。这一时期，三岛的政治立场日益激进，他认为日本失去了传统武士精神，需要通过极端行动唤醒国民。他的政治活动与文学创作交织，展现出对日本民族身份的深刻思考和对战后日本社会的不满。
points.descriptionEn: In 1968, Mishima founded the 'Tatenokai', a right-wing organization advocating for the restoration of imperial authority and opposing Westernization. He began publicly criticizing Japan's post-war democratic system, calling for a return to traditional values. In 1969, he completed the fourth volume of his final novel series 'The Sea of Fertility', 'The Decay of the Angel'. During this period, Mishima's political stance became increasingly radical. He believed Japan had lost its traditional samurai spirit and needed to awaken the nation through extreme actions. His political activities intertwined with his literary creation, showing his deep reflection on Japanese national identity and dissatisfaction with post-war Japanese society.

points.title: 戏剧性结局
points.description: 1970年11月25日，三岛由纪夫带领楯会成员占领日本陆上自卫队东部总监部，发表演说呼吁军队发动政变，恢复天皇权威。当政变失败后，他按照传统仪式切腹自杀，由其学生森田必胜协助完成介错。这一戏剧性震惊了日本乃至世界，成为三岛生命美学的最终实践。他的自杀被视为对战后日本社会的终极抗议，也是其一生追求的'行动美学'的极致体现。三岛的死亡使他成为日本文化中的一个复杂符号，代表着传统与现代、美与死亡、艺术与政治的交织。
points.descriptionEn: On November 25, 1970, Mishima led members of the Tatenokai to occupy the headquarters of the Eastern Army of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force, delivering a speech calling for a military coup to restore imperial authority. When the coup failed, he committed seppuku (ritual suicide) according to traditional ceremony, assisted by his student Masakazu Morita. This dramatic event shocked Japan and the world, becoming the ultimate realization of Mishima's aesthetic of life. His suicide was seen as the ultimate protest against post-war Japanese society and the ultimate embodiment of his lifelong pursuit of 'aesthetic of action'. Mishima's death made him a complex symbol in Japanese culture, representing the interweaving of tradition and modernity, beauty and death, art and politics.

appraisal.zh: 三岛由纪夫通常被定义为战后日本精神危机的复杂文化现象：其作品融合东西方文化，探究人性深处的矛盾与美，被广泛研究以考察传统与现代性的冲突，其影响还延伸至时尚、电影与流行文化，成为日本美学的国际代表。另一种看法认为，他的右翼立场与民族主义倾向助长军国主义复活之虞，切腹是极端的自我戏剧化，作品中的暴力、死亡与自恋则有美化危险思想之嫌。其生平与作品至今仍引发关于艺术、政治与民族身份的跨文化讨论。
appraisal.en: Mishima is generally defined as a complex cultural phenomenon of post-war Japan's spiritual crisis: his works fuse Eastern and Western culture and probe the contradictions and beauty of human nature, are widely studied for the conflict between tradition and modernity, and extend his influence into fashion, film and popular culture as an international emblem of Japanese aesthetics. Another view holds that his right-wing nationalism risked reviving militarism, that his seppuku was extreme self-dramatization, and that his violence, death and narcissism glorify dangerous ideas. His life and work still provoke cross-cultural debate on art, politics and national identity.

supporter.zh: 三岛由纪夫被视为日本战后文学的巨匠，他的作品融合东西方文化，探索人性深处的矛盾与美。他追求极致的美学体验，将文学创作提升为生命实践，最终以切腹自杀完成其艺术理念。三岛对传统日本美学的复兴和对战后日本精神危机的批判，使他成为文化保守主义的象征，其作品至今仍影响着日本文学和艺术的发展。
supporter.en: Mishima is regarded as a master of post-war Japanese literature, whose works integrate Eastern and Western cultures to explore the contradictions and beauty in human nature. He pursued extreme aesthetic experiences, elevating literary creation to life practice, ultimately realizing his artistic philosophy through seppuku. Mishima's revival of traditional Japanese aesthetics and critique of the spiritual crisis in post-war Japan made him a symbol of cultural conservatism, and his works continue to influence the development of Japanese literature and art.

critic.zh: 批评者认为三岛由纪夫的政治立场极端保守，其右翼思想和民族主义倾向助长了日本军国主义复活的可能性。他的自杀行为被视为一种极端的自我戏剧化，是对社会不负责任的表演。此外，三岛作品中频繁出现的暴力、死亡和自恋倾向，被批评为美化危险思想，对年轻读者产生不良影响。他的美学追求也被认为是脱离现实、逃避社会责任的表现。
critic.en: Critics argue that Mishima's political stance was extremely conservative, and his right-wing ideology and nationalist tendencies contributed to the potential revival of Japanese militarism. His suicide was seen as an extreme form of self-dramatization, an irresponsible performance towards society. Additionally, the frequent occurrence of violence, death, and narcissism in his works has been criticized as glorifying dangerous ideas and negatively influencing young readers. His pursuit of aesthetics was also considered detached from reality and an escape from social responsibility.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，三岛由纪夫被定义为一位复杂的文化现象，代表着战后日本精神危机的典型。他的作品被广泛研究，探讨日本传统与现代性的冲突。他的自杀事件成为20世纪最具震撼力的文化符号之一，反映了战后日本社会的身份焦虑。三岛的影响超越了文学领域，延伸至时尚、电影和流行文化，成为日本美学的国际代表。他的生平和作品持续引发关于艺术、政治、民族身份和生命意义的跨文化讨论。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Mishima is defined as a complex cultural phenomenon, representing the typical spiritual crisis of post-war Japan. His works are widely studied to explore the conflict between Japanese tradition and modernity. His suicide became one of the most shocking cultural symbols of the 20th century, reflecting the identity anxiety of post-war Japanese society. Mishima's influence extends beyond literature into fashion, film, and popular culture, making him an international representative of Japanese aesthetics. His life and work continue to inspire cross-cultural discussions about art, politics, national identity, and the meaning of life.

self.zh: 美，必须是危险的，否则就不是真正的美。
self.en: Beauty must be dangerous, otherwise it is not true beauty.
